We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have carefully evaluated your proposed options for DAP delivery and shorter lead times. While we cannot offer DAP delivery at the previous price, we can provide it at €16.30 per unit. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €16.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We remain open to discussing further price improvements if you can commit to a higher order volume. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
